main.description: Promote a ready draft VOD to a public place.stream.video record. The server carries over source and durationMs from the draft, backfills a generated thumbnail if the draft has none, writes the video record via putRecord, then deletes the draft.

uri.description: The ats:// URI of the draft to publish. Must have status 'ready'.

videoUri.description: AT-URI of the created place.stream.video record.

videoCid.description: CID of the created place.stream.video record.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No draft exists with the given URI for the authenticated user.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The draft is not ready to publish (status is 'processing' or 'error').
